reason: Half my customers order at the counter and I already know my regulars by name. I run my promos on Instagram and WhatsApp for free, so 59 lari a month plus another transaction fee on top of my terminal is money I don't have for something I mostly already do.
objection: I already pay for Wox and a card terminal. Another system with its own fees means more money and another payout to check every night, just to collect reviews and send messages I can already post myself.
would_change_my_mind: If the per-transaction fee was lower than what my bank terminal charges, so switching guests to QR payment actually saved me money instead of adding a cost.
